note: English A2 listening in the Cambridge A2 Key format (owner's plan 2026-10-30): Part 1 three pictures ×5 (en_pic3, pictures described, not drawn), Part 2 notes ×5 (en_fill, typed), Part 3 a conversation ×5 (en_q), Part 4 short recordings ×5 (en_talk), Part 5 matching ×5 (en_match, eight options). Each recording twice in the mock. Original texts. Drafted in tools/.mockups/en_a2_ls.py.

panels: a necklace in an open gift box
a taxi on a city street; the sign on its roof is plain and blank
a train at a station platform
a red double-decker bus; no writing, no numbers anywhere
a sunny beach with a bright sun in the sky
a street in heavy rain, people with umbrellas
a pair of glasses on a kitchen table next to a folded newspaper
a pair of glasses on a sofa cushion
a pair of glasses inside an open bag
two girls playing tennis on a court
a girl at a pop concert, waving
a girl swimming in an outdoor pool

lines.s: Did you get a present for your sister?
lines.zh: 你買到送你妹妹的禮物了嗎？
lines.en: Did you get a present for your sister?

lines.s: Yes. I was going to buy her a book, but she's got so many. Then I saw a lovely scarf, but it was too expensive, so I got her a necklace in the end.
lines.zh: 買了。本來想買書給她，可是她書太多了。後來看到一條很漂亮的圍巾，但太貴了，所以最後買了一條項鍊。
lines.en: Yes. I was going to buy her a book, but she's got so many. Then I saw a lovely scarf, but it was too expensive, so I got her a necklace in the end.

q.s: What did the boy buy for his sister?
q.en: What did the boy buy for his sister?

explain.zh: 書她太多、圍巾太貴，「最後買了一條項鍊」。
explain.en: Too many books, the scarf too expensive: a necklace in the end.

lines.s: Are you taking a taxi to the airport?
lines.zh: 你要搭計程車去機場嗎？
lines.en: Are you taking a taxi to the airport?

lines.s: No, they're too expensive. I'll get the train — it's quicker than the bus.
lines.zh: 不要，太貴了。我搭火車，比公車快。
lines.en: No, they're too expensive. I'll get the train — it's quicker than the bus.

q.s: How will the woman get to the airport?
q.en: How will the woman get to the airport?

explain.zh: 計程車太貴，「我搭火車，比公車快」。
explain.en: Taxis are too expensive; the train is quicker than the bus.

lines.s: Shall we go to the beach on Saturday?
lines.zh: 我們星期六去海邊好嗎？
lines.en: Shall we go to the beach on Saturday?

lines.s: The forecast says it'll rain in the morning, but it'll be sunny all afternoon.
lines.zh: 氣象預報說早上會下雨，但整個下午都是晴天。
lines.en: The forecast says it'll rain in the morning, but it'll be sunny all afternoon.

lines.s: Great — let's go after lunch, then.
lines.zh: 太好了，那我們吃完午飯再去。
lines.en: Great — let's go after lunch, then.

q.s: What will the weather be like on Saturday afternoon?
q.zh: 星期六下午天氣會怎麼樣？
q.en: What will the weather be like on Saturday afternoon?

explain.zh: 早上下雨，「整個下午都是晴天」。
explain.en: Rain in the morning, sunny all afternoon.

lines.s: Have you seen my glasses? I thought they were in my bag.
lines.zh: 你有看到我的眼鏡嗎？我以為放在包包裡。
lines.en: Have you seen my glasses? I thought they were in my bag.

lines.s: They're on the kitchen table, next to the newspaper.
lines.zh: 在廚房的桌子上，報紙旁邊。
lines.en: They're on the kitchen table, next to the newspaper.

explain.zh: 他以為在包包裡，但其實「在廚房的桌子上」。
explain.en: He thought in his bag, but they are on the kitchen table.

lines.s: Did you play tennis at the weekend?
lines.zh: 你週末有去打網球嗎？
lines.en: Did you play tennis at the weekend?

lines.s: No, it was too windy, so we went swimming instead. We're going to a concert next weekend.
lines.zh: 沒有，風太大了，所以我們改去游泳。下週末我們要去聽演唱會。
lines.en: No, it was too windy, so we went swimming instead. We're going to a concert next weekend.

q.s: What did the girl do at the weekend?
q.en: What did the girl do at the weekend?

explain.zh: 風太大沒打網球，「改去游泳」；演唱會是下週末。
explain.en: Too windy for tennis, so swimming; the concert is next weekend.

lines.s: Hello, everyone. I want to tell you about next month's trip to the science museum. We're going on Thursday the fourteenth of May — not Friday, as I said before. The coach will leave the school at half past eight, so please be in the car park by twenty past. The trip costs twelve pounds, and that includes lunch at the museum café. You'll need to bring a notebook and a pen, because there's a worksheet to complete. And don't forget to wear comfortable shoes — we'll be walking a lot. If you have any questions, please email me. My name is Mrs Green — that's G-R-E-E-N.
lines.zh: 大家好。我要跟大家說下個月去科學博物館的校外教學。我們五月十四日星期四出發——不是我之前說的星期五。遊覽車八點半從學校出發，所以請在八點二十分以前到停車場。這次活動十二英鎊，包含在博物館咖啡廳的午餐。要帶筆記本和一支筆，因為要寫學習單。還有別忘了穿好走的鞋子，我們會走很多路。有問題請寄電子郵件給我。我是格林老師，拼法是 G-R-E-E-N。
lines.en: Hello, everyone. I want to tell you about next month's trip to the science museum. We're going on Thursday the fourteenth of May — not Friday, as I said before. The coach will leave the school at half past eight, so please be in the car park by twenty past. The trip costs twelve pounds, and that includes lunch at the museum café. You'll need to bring a notebook and a pen, because there's a worksheet to complete. And don't forget to wear comfortable shoes — we'll be walking a lot. If you have any questions, please email me. My name is Mrs Green — that's G-R-E-E-N.

ask.zh: 出發日期：＿＿ 5 月 14 日

explain.zh: 「五月十四日星期四——不是我之前說的星期五」。
「遊覽車八點半從學校出發」；八點二十分是要到停車場的時間。
explain.en: It leaves at 8.30; be there by 8.20.

explain.zh: 「這次活動十二英鎊」。
「要帶筆記本和一支筆」。
「我是格林老師，拼法是 G-R-E-E-N」。

lines.s: Hi Emma! How's the new job going?
lines.zh: 嗨，艾瑪！新工作怎麼樣？
lines.en: Hi Emma! How's the new job going?

lines.s: Really well, thanks. I've been working at the cinema for three weeks now.
lines.zh: 很好，謝謝。我在電影院工作三個星期了。
lines.en: Really well, thanks. I've been working at the cinema for three weeks now.

lines.s: What do you do there?
lines.zh: 你在那裡做什麼？
lines.en: What do you do there?

lines.s: Mostly I sell tickets, but sometimes I help in the café, making popcorn and drinks.
lines.zh: 大部分時間在賣票，有時候也在咖啡吧幫忙做爆米花和飲料。
lines.en: Mostly I sell tickets, but sometimes I help in the café, making popcorn and drinks.

lines.s: Do you get to watch the films for free?
lines.zh: 你可以免費看電影嗎？
lines.en: Do you get to watch the films for free?

lines.s: Yes — on Mondays, staff can see any film they like. Last week I saw the new space film. It was brilliant, but quite long — nearly three hours!
lines.zh: 可以，星期一員工想看哪部都可以。上週我看了新的太空片，超好看，但滿長的，將近三個小時！
lines.en: Yes — on Mondays, staff can see any film they like. Last week I saw the new space film. It was brilliant, but quite long — nearly three hours!

lines.s: What are your hours like?
lines.zh: 你的上班時間怎麼樣？
lines.en: What are your hours like?

lines.s: I work on Friday and Saturday evenings, from six until eleven. And I'm saving up to go to Spain with my cousins in the summer.
lines.zh: 星期五和星期六晚上，六點到十一點。我在存錢，暑假要和表姊妹去西班牙。
lines.en: I work on Friday and Saturday evenings, from six until eleven. And I'm saving up to go to Spain with my cousins in the summer.

ask.s: How long has Emma worked at the cinema?
ask.zh: 艾瑪在電影院工作多久了？
ask.en: How long has Emma worked at the cinema?

explain.zh: 「我在電影院工作三個星期了」。

ask.s: What does Emma do most of the time?
ask.zh: 艾瑪大部分時間做什麼？
ask.en: What does Emma do most of the time?

explain.zh: 「大部分時間在賣票」，做爆米花只是有時候。

ask.s: When can staff see films for free?
ask.zh: 員工什麼時候可以免費看電影？
ask.en: When can staff see films for free?

explain.zh: 「星期一員工想看哪部都可以」。

ask.s: What did Emma think of the space film?
ask.zh: 艾瑪覺得那部太空片怎麼樣？
ask.en: What did Emma think of the space film?

explain.zh: 「超好看」（brilliant），而且很長，不是太短。
「暑假要和表姊妹去西班牙」：為了旅行。

lines.s: You will hear a woman talking about a restaurant.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位女士談一家餐廳。
lines.en: You will hear a woman talking about a restaurant.

lines.s: The food at Rosa's is lovely, and the waiters are really friendly. The only problem is that it's quite hard to find — it's down a little street behind the station.
lines.zh: 羅莎餐廳的菜很好吃，服務生也很親切。唯一的問題是不太好找，在車站後面的一條小街上。
lines.en: The food at Rosa's is lovely, and the waiters are really friendly. The only problem is that it's quite hard to find — it's down a little street behind the station.

ask.s: What does the woman say about the restaurant?
ask.en: What does the woman say about the restaurant?

explain.zh: 「唯一的問題是不太好找」；服務生很親切，地點在車站後面。
explain.en: Hard to find; friendly waiters; behind the station.

lines.s: You will hear a boy talking to his mother.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個男孩和媽媽說話。
lines.en: You will hear a boy talking to his mother.

lines.s: Mum, can I borrow your laptop? Mine is broken, and I need to finish my history project tonight.
lines.zh: 媽，可以借你的筆電嗎？我的壞了，今晚要把歷史作業做完。
lines.en: Mum, can I borrow your laptop? Mine is broken, and I need to finish my history project tonight.

lines.s: OK, but I need it back by nine.
lines.zh: 好，但九點前要還我。
lines.en: OK, but I need it back by nine.

ask.s: Why does the boy want the laptop?
ask.en: Why does the boy want the laptop?

explain.zh: 「今晚要把歷史作業做完」。

lines.s: You will hear a man leaving a message.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士留言。
lines.en: You will hear a man leaving a message.

lines.s: Hi Lucy, it's Dan. I can't meet you at the café at four — my train is late. Can we meet at five instead, at the same place?
lines.zh: 露西，我是丹。我沒辦法四點在咖啡店跟你見面，火車誤點了。改成五點好嗎？地點一樣。
lines.en: Hi Lucy, it's Dan. I can't meet you at the café at four — my train is late. Can we meet at five instead, at the same place?

ask.s: What does Dan want to change?
ask.en: What does Dan want to change?

explain.zh: 四點改成五點，「地點一樣」：改的是時間。
explain.en: Four to five, same place: the time.

lines.s: You will hear two friends talking about a party.
lines.zh: 你會聽到兩個朋友談一個派對。
lines.en: You will hear two friends talking about a party.

lines.s: Are you going to Tom's party?
lines.zh: 你要去湯姆的派對嗎？
lines.en: Are you going to Tom's party?

lines.s: I'd love to, but my grandparents are visiting that weekend, so I have to stay at home.
lines.zh: 很想去，可是那個週末我爺爺奶奶要來，所以得待在家。
lines.en: I'd love to, but my grandparents are visiting that weekend, so I have to stay at home.

ask.s: Why can't the boy go to the party?
ask.zh: 男孩為什麼不能去派對？
ask.en: Why can't the boy go to the party?

options.t: He has to see his family.

explain.zh: 「爺爺奶奶要來，所以得待在家」。

lines.s: You will hear a girl talking about her new hobby.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩談她的新嗜好。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking about her new hobby.

lines.s: I started taking photos last year. I mostly take pictures of animals, especially birds. Next month I'm entering a competition.
lines.zh: 我去年開始拍照，大多拍動物，尤其是鳥。下個月我要參加比賽。
lines.en: I started taking photos last year. I mostly take pictures of animals, especially birds. Next month I'm entering a competition.

ask.s: What does the girl usually take photos of?
ask.en: What does the girl usually take photos of?

explain.zh: 「大多拍動物，尤其是鳥」。

lines.s: So, what's everyone bringing to the picnic on Sunday?
lines.zh: 那麼，星期天的野餐大家要帶什麼？
lines.en: So, what's everyone bringing to the picnic on Sunday?

lines.s: Well, Anna said she'd bake a cake — she's really good at that.
lines.zh: 安娜說她要烤蛋糕，她很會烤。
lines.en: Well, Anna said she'd bake a cake — she's really good at that.

lines.s: Lovely. What about Ben? He usually brings drinks.
lines.zh: 太好了。班呢？他通常帶飲料。
lines.en: Lovely. What about Ben? He usually brings drinks.

lines.s: Not this time. He's going to the market on Saturday, so he'll get some fruit.
lines.zh: 這次不是。他星期六要去市場，所以會買水果。
lines.en: Not this time. He's going to the market on Saturday, so he'll get some fruit.

lines.s: OK. And Chloe?
lines.zh: 好。克蘿伊呢？
lines.en: OK. And Chloe?

lines.s: Chloe wanted to bring ice cream, but it would melt, so she's making a big salad instead.
lines.zh: 克蘿伊本來想帶冰淇淋，可是會融化，所以改做一大盤沙拉。
lines.en: Chloe wanted to bring ice cream, but it would melt, so she's making a big salad instead.

lines.s: Good idea. Is David bringing the drinks, then?
lines.zh: 好主意。那大衛帶飲料嗎？
lines.en: Good idea. Is David bringing the drinks, then?

lines.s: Yes — lemonade and water. And Ella said she'd make sandwiches for everyone.
lines.zh: 對，檸檬汽水和水。艾拉說她要幫大家做三明治。
lines.en: Yes — lemonade and water. And Ella said she'd make sandwiches for everyone.

lines.s: Great. Then I'll bring some bread and cheese.
lines.zh: 太好了，那我帶麵包和起司。
lines.en: Great. Then I'll bring some bread and cheese.

explain.zh: 「安娜說她要烤蛋糕」。
班通常帶飲料，「這次不是」，他會買水果。
冰淇淋會融化，「改做一大盤沙拉」。
大衛帶「檸檬汽水和水」。
「艾拉說她要幫大家做三明治」；麵包和起司是女的要帶的。
explain.en: Sandwiches; the bread and cheese are the woman's.
